# preprocess.prepare_proteomic { #falconage.preprocess.prepare_proteomic }

```python
preprocess.prepare_proteomic(data, *, reference=None, standardise='reference')
```

Put a proteomic matrix on the scale a clock's coefficients expect.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default       |
|-------------|----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| reference   | pd.DataFrame \| None | Two columns, ``mean`` and ``sd``, indexed by protein: the *training cohort's* statistics, which travel with the model. This is the correct input and the default path.                                                                                                                             | `None`        |
| standardise | str                  | ``"reference"`` uses the frame above. ``"cohort"`` computes the mean and SD from the data in front of you -- available, refused for a single sample, and recorded in ``uns`` as a deviation, because it makes every score depend on who else was in the batch. ``"none"`` leaves the matrix alone. | `'reference'` |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                                               |
|--------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | DataError | For ``standardise="reference"`` with no reference given. There is no sensible fallback: silently switching to the cohort would produce the exact failure the parameter exists to prevent. |
